translation: (At the head of the shoulder-blade bone on the shoulder rim, in the hollow of the depression between the two bones; raise the arm to find it, and there is a gap.) Ascending at Renying it flanks the corner of the mouth, joining hand-foot Yangming and the Ren meridian at Dicang (ST4) (flanking the corner of the mouth four fen, toward the outside and slightly below, where there is a place of a faintly moving vessel). Together with Foot Yangming it ascends running at Juliao (ST3) (flanking the nostril eight fen, directly below the pupil, level with Shuigou (DU26)), then once more joins the Ren meridian at Chengqi (ST1) (seven fen below the eye, directly below the pupil, in the depression). Reaching the inner canthus of the eye, it joins the five vessels — hand-foot Taiyang, Foot Yangming, and the Yin Qiao — at the Jingming point.
